**Title:** [Phase 3] Draft legal operating agreement with core rules

**Labels:** phase-3, legal

**Body:**

Create the foundational legal document that will govern the pilot.

Must explicitly include:
- Hard 10% non-profit allocation rule (enforceable)
- One home = one vote with physical verification requirement
- Founder recall mechanism (proactive retirement vote built in)
- Protection / insurance rules instead of foreclosure
- Rate buy-down and participation mechanics

Coordinate with entity formation work.

**References:**
- `specs/requirements_and_tokenomics.md`
- `specs/governance.md`
- Entity formation issue

**Acceptance criteria:**
- First draft of the operating agreement in the repo (or linked)
- Review checklist against whitepaper and specs
- Version controlled with change log

**Milestone:** Phase 3 - Pilot Launch
